title: LINZ natural-colour terrain basemap TileMill preview (2013)
credit: Crown copyright 2013, Land Information New Zealand and the New Zealand Government
altText: Archival miniature of a natural-colour South Island terrain relief basemap with shaded mountains, forests, open land and coastal sea.
caption: Original 256-pixel TileMill project preview in LINZ's 2013 open-licensed natural-colour basemap reconstruction archive. This is a LINZ basemap preview, not a Geographx 4 m commercial source tile.
context: The original file is preserved without alteration from LINZ's GitHub master tree; the 2013 licensing statement is in the parent README. Contextual illustration only; no in-chapter figure placement.
